title: Nasruddin and the Honey Jar
summary: Nasruddin's wife hid a jar of golden honey on the top shelf, warning him: "Husband, do not touch that jar! It contains lethal poison; a single spoonful will cause sudden death!"...
full_text:
Nasruddin's wife hid a jar of golden honey on the top shelf, warning him: "Husband, do not touch that jar! It contains lethal poison; a single spoonful will cause sudden death!"

While she was visiting neighbors, Nasruddin pulled down the jar, fetched a loaf of fresh bread, and ate every single drop of the honey.

When his wife returned and found the jar empty, Nasruddin lay on the floor groaning: "Forgive me, wife! I broke your favorite bowl, and was so filled with remorse that I ate the entire jar of poison so I could die in peace! But alas, the poison has not worked yet!"
moral: Cunning warnings often tempt the curious into discovering the sweet truth.
